verdict.reasons: The primary commercial product identity is strictly adhered to: exactly one recognizable AFP drip-tape carton roll is present, correctly oriented and clearly displayed on the soil. The branding and watermark ('AFP | 09134922013') are authentic and readable. However, the visual fails to match the specific article evidence requested; the image displays a continuous black supply pipe with a visible open end, rather than the required closed ribbed compression union installed inline between two pipes. Because all core product, layout, and scene conditions are strictly met and the missing technical evidence constitutes an advisory mismatch, it is accepted under practical editorial criteria.

focused_physical_review.reason: The white and blue AFP package sits on the soil with a broad, uninterrupted gap around its front, left, and back, but a white strip/ribbon emerges from the right side of the package, preventing a clear gap on that side. The main black irrigation line is separated from the package by a clear distance. There are no additional loose coils or rolls besides the main package.
